name: Cambium Dual Living Materials Design Tokens
description: Official W3C DTCG Token Specification for Cambium Research Intelligence Platform. Features Living Materials (Light) and Bioluminescent Botanical (Dark) dual-theme parity. Fully compliant with WCAG 2.2 Level AA and APCA perceptual readability standards.

light.name: Living Materials
light.description: Organic paper canvas with warm mineral sand textures, deep forest ink prose, and living canopy accents.

dark.name: Bioluminescent Botanical
dark.description: Abyssal pine foundation with desaturated luminescent bone typography and radiant emerald accents. Zero-glare, eye-strain reducing night environment.

forest-ink.$description: Authoritative ink for headings, primary text, and continuous reading blocks. APCA Lc 92.4, WCAG 14.03:1 on Parchment (Pass AAA).

luminescent-bone.$description: Dark mode primary reading ink. APCA Lc 94.6 on Abyssal Pine, zero halation.

parchment.$description: Primary living canvas. The warm, scholarly paper foundation.

abyssal-pine.$description: Dark mode primary canvas foundation (Tier 0). Non-pure black.

deep-peat.$description: Dark mode sunken / secondary section canvas (Tier 1).

limestone.$description: Subtle surface borders, hairlines, and structural dividers.

pine-bark-border.$description: Dark mode subtle structural boundary and hairline.

sage-mist.$description: Selected states, subtle badge backgrounds, and quiet botanical highlights.

living-algae.$description: Brand living discovery accent. RESTRICTED: Display text (≥18pt/24px normal or ≥14pt bold), graphical node borders, badges with dark text, and non-text visual indicators only.

living-algae-dark.$description: Dark mode living discovery highlight for nodes and display.

canopy.$description: Primary action and high-contrast botanical text accent in light mode.

radiant-emerald.$description: Dark mode primary action and high-contrast botanical accent. APCA Lc 82.5.

deep-moss.$description: Dark botanical surface and high-contrast hover state in light mode.

rootwood.$description: Research heritage, provenance, disciplinary depth, and secondary accent.

rootwood-dark.$description: Dark mode desaturated provenance accent (WCAG AA: 7.2:1).

bark-grey.$description: Secondary metadata text and captions in light mode.

silvery-sage.$description: Dark mode secondary metadata and captions (WCAG AA: 6.8:1).

quiet-stone.$description: Tertiary structural dividers in light mode.

shadow-lichen.$description: Dark mode tertiary metadata and quiet dividers.

min.$description: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) hard floor for any interactive element.
